params.1266: So That's What Ess Stands For
params.1273: Mine some rune or pure essence.
params.1292: Completing this Task will give an amount of money based on total Tasks completed, and an air talisman.
params.1274: You must have completed Rune Mysteries, and you will need a pickaxe to mine the essence.
params.1275: Talk to a wizard such as Sedridor to teleport to the mine.
params.2225: Essence is the vital raw material for the crafting of runes to use in spells.
